cadBlockers: disconnected source topology: piece(s) 1, 4, 5 — exact occupancy with invalid pieces; regression fixture, not a CAD candidate
note: Canonical patches are trim regions on frozen physical-piece carriers. Mixed Cube B contacts are subdivided, then consolidated onto shared analytic surfaces when they agree geometrically. Junctions are solved with residual reports. GPU is not used.

junctions.note: Trim curves are analytic or numerically traced intersections clipped by voxel adjacency. Voxel polylines only select the branch. NURBS are not used.

closure.note: Carriers are frozen. Junctions are solved onto incident surfaces with a residual report; incompatible endpoints are not snapped. GPU is not used. NURBS are not used.
